method_proposed: APFS independent copy-on-write clone replacement; retain each counterpart unchanged, clone to sibling temporary file, restore the target exact fullmode and original atime_ns/mtime_ns, verify exact bytes and metadata, then atomic replacement by Root

batch1_verification.prior_mtime_preservation_scope: receipt-recorded only; receipt does not include original timestamp values

eligibility.selection: Only the eight previously identified duplicate Git-blob groups, with paths in frozen source banks or content-addressed archive objects. No current report JSONs, .cinder files, live caches, mailbox, settings, worker checkout files, or Git metadata are candidates. Archived source/files/.godot/imported inputs are committed frozen evidence, not the live .godot cache.
eligibility.physical_check: Every included file is a regular nonsymlink file; exact SHA256 and byte length match the literal committed Git blob; fullmode, inode, device, mtime and ctime are unchanged across hashing. All targets share counterpart device, are separate inodes with nlink=1, and have zero BSD flags. Each counterpart is omitted from replacement rows.
eligibility.physical_mode_note: Git 100644 records nonexecutable status, not complete physical permissions. Physical 0664 copies are included with their exact fullmode; restore target permissions on the temporary clone before replacement.
eligibility.atime_scope: Exact atime_ns recorded after the read-only hashing pass; Root must capture and preserve current atime/mtime immediately before its clone operation, because later reads may advance atime.

preconditions_for_root_execution: Revalidate every target and retained counterpart against recorded Git blob/SHA/size/fullmode/mtime/inode/device before replacement; abort if changed.
Keep all eight retained counterparts unchanged.

Do not create hardlinks; use independent copy-on-write clone semantics. Restore each target original fullmode and atime_ns/mtime_ns on the temporary clone, including any physical mode difference from the source.
No writes outside listed replacement rows and sibling temporary clone files.
Measure filesystem free bytes before and after; st_blocks counts do not identify exclusive APFS extents.
allocation_limit: Allocated bytes are st_blocks*512 per target, an upper bound on nominal duplicate allocation. Existing APFS extent sharing is not detected, so this is potential reclaim, not measured guaranteed savings.
